quest.title: Venti's New Plan
quest.description: Venti's plan to sweet talk his way into getting the Holy Lyre back backfires. He's come up with a new plan, but seems he'll need your help for it to work.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Mora x5450, Character EXP x2850, Fine Enhancement Ore x5

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It didn't work... I knew it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You "knew it"?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #I just wanted to know how influential {NICKNAME} — the hotshot of the Knights of the Favonius — is.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: You see, the best warrior should always be presented with the best sword, and yet here we are...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Does the story not make for a fitting ballad?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So what are you trying to say? That we're not good enough?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: No, that's not it. More of a commentary regarding Mondstadt's inability to see the warrior standing right before its very eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Very well. Looks like borrowing it is not going to be possible. We're simply going to have to steal it.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Today we stand for free will! Any suggestions on just how we steal it?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Come now, speak up. That's what free will is for.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't want to steal anything!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hahaha, look at you. Sidetracked from the start.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: But seriously, you're more suitable for the job than I.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Aside from singing, I don't really have any other talents.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Besides, if I was caught, I'd have no one to right the grave injustice of my arrest.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How can it be a "grave injustice" if you got caught stealing red-handed?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #But things are different for {NICKNAME}. You are the superstar of the Knights of Favonius. You have made contributions to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Should you get caught, you would easily be able to talk your way out of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Stop mentioning us getting caught!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}... What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sorry— Wait... Did you just say... you're Barbatos?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Seems I did mention that...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Your point being?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If you really are a god, then we can't simply abandon you.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Why does your decision hinge upon whether or not I am a god?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon'll fill you in on {NICKNAME}'s background story when we get the time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And if you're not a god, then I'll help Dvalin anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Huh?

choices.text: I will bring you the Holy Lyre der Himmel.
I don't want to see another separation.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Replacement cutscene and gameplay: sneaking in to steal the Holy Lyre

talks.objective: Infiltrate the basement and obtain the Holy Lyre der Himmel

dialogues.speaker: Shopkeeper 02
dialogues.text: Freeze!

dialogues.speaker: Gotelinde
dialogues.text: The Church has been a mess recently, and the Seneschal is not here... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Don't be shy. Go.

dialogues.speaker: Otto
dialogues.text: Man, this stinks. Having to stand around here all <color=#00E1FFFF>day</color> long, having to guard this entrance.\nHey! Don't move! You can't go down there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems we're gonna have to wait until <color=#00E1FFFF>nightfall</color> to sneak in...
